about.title: About AJI Editions
about.p1Before: AJI Editions is the multi-year edition line of
about.p1After: . Switch between paired CAS partition tables and JCR impact factor datasets from different release years to search, browse, and compare journal metrics in one place.
about.p2: The platform provides key metrics such as Impact Factor, CAS or XR partition rankings, and authority level, helping users evaluate and select journals for publication. You can also create an account to save favorite journals for easy access.
about.p3: All journal data is based on publicly available information and is intended for reference purposes. Data may contain errors. Verify important information before use.
about.dataSourceIntro: Each edition pairs a partition table with the latest JCR impact factor available at its release date:

links.academicJournalIndex: yuzhounh/academic-journal-index: Search journals by title or browse journals by category.

search.title: Searching for Journals
search.p1: Use the search bar on the 'Search' page to find journals by name. You need to enter at least three characters to start the search. Results are sorted by impact factor by default.

browse.title: Browsing Categories
browse.p1: Go to the 'Browse' page to see all available journal categories. Click on any category to view a list of journals within it, sorted by their CAS partition ranking.

favorites.title: Managing Favorites
favorites.p1: After logging in, you can add any journal to your favorites by clicking the heart icon on its detail page. Your favorites are available on the 'Favorites' page, organized in lists.

ai.title: AI-Powered Analysis
ai.p1: Opening a journal's detail page automatically loads AI-powered analysis, including a summary of the journal and related publication recommendations.

feedback.title: Questions & Feedback
feedback.p1: Have a question or a suggestion to improve the website? We'd love to hear from you! Please open an issue on our GitHub repository.
